visual_logic.surface_detail: Sleek 'Sandy Gold' skin with 'Olive' lateral stripes, mimicking tiger shark patterns, mapped uniformly across its horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the elongated, slender skull and the lizard-like neck oriented parallel to the camera plane.

environment.water: Warm, silt-rich coastal water with 'River-Silt Brown' particulates, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The submerged tree roots and large prehistoric turtles are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The primitive tethysaurine mosasaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original tight curling pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its slender skull, flexible torso, limbs, and long tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
